New York: De Beers just became sole owner of Canada's last diamond mine, and paid nothing in cash to do it.

Mountain Province agreed 1 October to hand its 49% stake in Gahcho Kué to De Beers, settling every debt owed. Diavik closed in March; Ekati filed for insolvency this spring. De Beers now owns Canada's only diamond mine.

New York: two vintage Rolex chronographs could each fetch close to $1.2 million at a Geneva sale this November.

Sixteen watches from collector Pucci Papaleo's 70-piece Rolex archive, built over 30 years, go into Phillips' Geneva Watch Auction XXIV on 7 and 8 November. A circa-1941 square-cased chronograph is considered unique, with no other example recorded at auction.
